scope: Green LIVE canary risk projection and pre-execution reservations only. No profit ceiling, PAPER size, active model/policy or runtime activation change.
source_grain: One original buy intent/SQL position, with complete unique original sell intents for its native-cash close. Historical SQL positions without original journals remain unproved.
implementation: No import-time operator state initialization; LIVE startup reconciles before supervision, and each green admission reconciles current committed SQL and both active/resolved original journals.

Checksummed atomic state retains original identities, causal buy fields, complete sell/fill fingerprints, original UTC event days, daily losses, loss streaks, pending/unproved execution and unknown closes across restart.

Final risk revalidation and a serialized durable original-intent reservation precede buyer/signing/dispatch. Repeated reservations cannot resend. Proved no-send risk rejections are retained as terminal no-fill originals.

Missing sources, changed or rewound identities, wrong SQL run/mint/signature, discontinuous partial coverage, unfinalized chain receipts, corrupt state, failed SQL or disk writes block new green LIVE risk.

Conservative native cash uses each original checked buy/sell wallet receipt, integer raw units, complete partial quantities, the same wallet/decimals, exact original final-close time/signature and wallet network fees. No current SOL/USD lookup or scalar PnL can update production risk.

LIVE size and remaining principal budget are checked without modifying configured caps. Gains never offset cumulative daily loss. Liquidity-crush disable time derives from the original close, not the replay clock; explicit disable deadlines persist.

PAPER remains exact 0.1 SOL with existing uncapped runners and never initializes or mutates this LIVE risk store. Tests use temporary sources, synthetic keys/SDK/RPC observations and no provider/order.
